details: The integrated synthetic Miniflare D1/R2 + real Worker + Chromium test now proves an archived image is absent from the actual Editor image picker, then after Media Library restore the same ID reappears and can be selected for a private Canvas preview.

Explicit Save stores the restored ID in the draft while leaving the exact prior published snapshot and public no-background rendering unchanged; the private media route remains separate from public delivery.

After Editor reload, the saved restored selection remains private; only a distinct explicit Publish updates the public snapshot, grants the public media route, and renders the image on the public page.

A previous assertion expected the original asset to remain published even though an earlier explicit Publish in the same test had removed it. The baseline and assertion now reflect that actual sequence; the test separately checks exact snapshot equality across Save.
The Editor public-tab helper increases only its maximum wait from 15 to 30 seconds and includes current DOM state in timeout diagnostics. Its existing selected-tab assertions are unchanged.
